title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We're working with a leading German health insurance provider that actively shapes the future of healthcare. This organisation supports over 12 million insured individuals, constantly innovating and improving services through the ideas and dedication of over 15,000 employees. Join a team committed to progress, innovation, and service excellence.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

* Develop, maintain, and enhance existing applications throughout the entire software development lifecycle
* Plan, manage, and implement complex programming tasks
* Ensure high code quality, system stability, and comprehensive test coverage
* Take responsibility for and ensure stable production operations
* Collaborate effectively with Product Owners, Product Architects, developers, internal stakeholders, and customers


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Completed degree in Computer Science or equivalent qualification, with at least five years of Full Stack Java expertise
* Experience with React is highly desirable
* Passion for clean code and mature software craftsmanship, including experience with AI tools in development
* Strong competence in testing, automation, and experience with TDD and BDD
* Profound knowledge in developing and integrating interfaces (e.g., REST) and microservices
* Experience with monolithic and legacy codebases, particularly their refactoring
* Solid understanding of CI/CD, especially GitHub Actions


 What's On Offer
   

  

* 35\.5\-hour work week and flexible working hours
* Company pension scheme and capital\-forming benefits
* 30 days of annual leave, plus additional days off on December 24th and 31st
* Hybrid work model with options for remote work


 Apply via Haystack today!
